scores.note: Option 5 'grievous' is odd with 'situation' (it modifies harm or errors); option 9 'egregious' likewise fits errors or violations, not a situation. 'abominable', 'atrocious', 'horrific' intensify somewhat; best picks 'deplorable' and 'dire' sit at 3-4 behind plain 'terrible'/'awful'.
